meta.title: XMind to Excel
meta.description: Converts .xmind mind maps into .xlsx workbooks with two tools. xmind_to_excel writes one of four views — outline (one row per node with level columns), testcase (cases whose titles start with the verbs 验证/校验/测试), checklist (cases chosen by tree level, expectations taken from child nodes), matrix (leaf paths with merged ancestor cells) — or all of them at once, plus a qa view with the fixed header 模块/子模块/用例场景/优先级/前置条件/操作步骤/预期结果/XMind 来源 and a 分类核对 sheet that reviews every precondition/step decision. xmind_inspect first summarizes canvases, node counts, the depth distribution, sample titles and a dialect profile, so the view and the case levels fit the map. The workbook is written next to the input file unless an output path is given; input is limited to 50 MB. Everything runs locally: no network requests and no uploads. Only text structure is converted — images, stickers, relationship lines, summaries and layout positions are dropped, and floating topics appear as ordinary children. Precondition and step extraction is rule-based: undecided nodes are appended to 用例场景 by default and recorded in a review sheet instead of being dropped or guessed. Turning the bundle off removes both tools and the bundled skill.
